[list]
[*] Mushkin bored ui was not showing the progress for de-spawn

[*] Missing functionality on the frochest

[*] other...

notes.title: Patch notes V 0.0.3
notes.notes:
New features and improvements:
- Mushkin become bored after a while without parties
- Forager countdown timer added to the UI
- Players have control on when parties end, giving them a bit of breathing room and time to play mini games
- Added rythm mini game to Mushkin
- Added glossary to the Book
- Added bottom panel buttons for quick Npc access
- The rainbow shader has been polished
- Added missing damage visuals on defense Mushkin + projectiles support

Bug fixes:
- Notifications Visual bug 
- Foragers despawn while foraging will not despawn foragers
- Side panel closes without properly opening
- Backgroung music doesn't loop
- Nutrient producers progress bar going the wrong way
- Timers not paused on party days

notes.title: Update notes V0.0.1
notes.notes:
Thanks for your feedback so far! This is what this update include:
- Removed time mechanic, as it was not adding but subtracting from the gameplay
- Added missing sound effects for various game objects
- Added feeding mechanic
- Fixed various bugs

notes.title: Playtest is now live
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome,

Thank you for your interest in play testing [b]Boggie Fungi[/b], to do so simply [b]request access[/b] and most should simply be accepted to participate.

Do remember to leave your feedback for the game, in this first round I am looking to know generalities of the game feel and pace, the game doesn't have a tutorial so I am also expecting to see some questions regarding progression around here. And if you really want to be a GOAT please answer [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScDW0cGD53pSJoJ9XXZrTGNrxITipvpd2x0ZcW0MbcFGtfctg/viewform?usp=dialog]this form[/url] as that would give me a better understanding of how the game is perceived. 

Besides that, I am keeping the feedback open to let everyone who participates so share your thoughts and first impressions in the forum!

Again, thank you for participating, this is a solo dev game so any help is appreciated. Also if you haven't yet do wishlist the game or share with a friend who you think would enjoy Boggie Fungi.

See you in the forums,
Karanva the one who draws with woobly lines
